title: BA Scoping Agent Invocation
description: The invocation envelope for the BA Scoping Agent (ba-scoping-agent). Validated before any graph access. Distinct from the consumed codebase-context.json (referenced by codebase_context) and from the produced product-graph.schema.json artifact. A run is one of two passes: 'scope' (propose Feature/Concepts/Questions, compute readiness) or 'ratify' (capture human answers as Decisions, recompute readiness, render brief).

feature_intent.description: The raw feature idea. Becomes the FEAT-* node title.

product_key.description: Product/repo scope, e.g. 'reformai-product'. Mirrors codebase-context target_key and graph_nodes.product_key.

tenant.description: Company selector. EXACTLY ONE of name or id. Resolved to app.current_tenant_id. Never resolved by LIMIT 1 (multiple companies exist: ReformAI, AfterGlow, Personal).

codebase_context.description: A validated codebase-context.json instance. MUST validate against codebase-context.schema.json before use; abort with validation_error otherwise. The agent never reads source code - this artifact is its only view of IS-state.

concepts_to_check.description: Directed existence-check list forwarded to the Codebase Context Agent. Additive only: directs existence-checking, never narrows domain_signals or coverage. Plain nouns or {noun, expected_kind}.

pass.description: 'scope' = Pass A (propose nodes, generate Questions, compute readiness). 'ratify' = Pass B (capture human_answers as Decisions, recompute readiness, render brief).

human_answers.description: Required for pass='ratify'. Each answer may produce MULTIPLE Decisions when it resolves multiple forks - the agent decomposes.

question_key.description: The QST-* node this answer resolves.

ratified_by.description: Human operator id stamped onto resulting accepted Decisions.

run_id.description: Optional caller-supplied telemetry run_id. Generated if absent.
